title: ricinus communis subvar. purpurascens
intro: Ricinus communis subvar. purpurascens, commonly known as the Purple Castor Bean, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family, closely related to the well-known Castor Bean (Ricinus communis). The Purple Castor Bean is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for pain relief, muscle spasms, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Purple Castor Bean include ricinoleic acid, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
